title: Frontend: Parking lot tab — list, add, archive, and promote ideas
description: Build the Parking Lot tab for managing project ideas that aren't prioritized yet.
acceptanceCriteria: Lists active (non-archived) parking lot items by default
'Show archived' toggle to include archived items
Each item shows: title, description preview, AI pathway button, promote button, archive button
AI Pathway button: calls generate pathway API and displays result in an expandable panel
Promote button: dialog to choose 'Promote to Milestone' or 'Promote to Todo'

steps.details: Create src/components/project/tabs/ParkingLotTab.tsx. Fetch items with useQuery. Toggle state for includeArchived. 'Add Idea' form at top (title + description inputs).

Create src/components/project/ParkingLotItem.tsx. Shows title, truncated description. Action buttons: AI Pathway (loading spinner while generating), Promote (opens choice dialog), Archive (calls archive API). If ai_pathway exists, show 'View Pathway' toggle button.
Expandable section below item. If ai_pathway is null: 'Generate Pathway' button → POST /ai-pathway → sets pathway on item. If ai_pathway exists: render as markdown using react-markdown.
shadcn/ui Dialog with two choices (radio buttons): 'Add as Milestone' and 'Add as Todo'. Confirm button: POST /promote, then invalidate milestones or todos query.
Add 2 ideas. Generate pathway for one — verify it displays. Promote one to milestone — verify it appears in milestones tab. Archive one — verify it's gone from list.
